caption: The drawing depicts a detailed technical illustration of a chair, rendered in pencil on a light beige or off-white paper. The illustration features two views of the chair: a frontal elevation on the left and a side elevation on the right. The front view shows an intricately designed high-back chair with ornamental scroll patterns and symmetrical carvings on the top, sides, and lower sections. The central backrest includes a rectangular caned area surrounded by further scrollwork. The chair's legs are turned and decorated with carved elements; the arms curve outward with an additional scroll at the ends. The side view reveals a gently sloping backrest, the scroll-shaped armrest, and the turned legs connected by stretchers. Dimensional annotations in inches are marked next to various parts of the chair in both views, and beneath the drawings, “SCALE: 3/8 = 1'” is written, indicating the drawing’s scale. The chair is composed entirely of light graphite lines, highlighting structural and ornamental components on an uncolored background.
title: Drawing of a Chair
